cues.text: In the dorm lounge, you sit on the sofas with Akihiko, Yukari, Junpei, Fuuka, Ken and Koromaru. Akihiko sits in an armchair with his arms folded.
The meeting breaks up. Yukari gets up and walks off, and Fuuka goes after her.
Yukari stops and turns around. Fuuka catches up and hands her something.
